source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Whenever one of your **ASTRA MILITARUM** models is allocated a ranged attack while at least one attacking model cannot fully see it because this **BANEBLADE** model is in the way, that model receives the **Benefit of Cover** versus that attack.
